title: Capable Tournament Winners
body:
In a tournament each game has 3 rounds and every player holds exactly three power boosters, used at most once per game; the higher booster wins a round. The i-th of n players has boosters (power_a[i], power_b[i], power_c[i]).

A player X is capable of defeating player Y if, choosing the order of boosters, X can win at least 2 of the 3 rounds. Count the players who are capable of defeating every other player.

Function to complete

Complete findCapableWinners(power_a, power_b, power_c). It returns the number of players capable of defeating every other player.

  • power_a: first booster of each player
  • power_b: second booster of each player
  • power_c: third booster of each player

Input reading and printing are handled for you, like on LeetCode. The input format below is what the tests and Custom input use.
inp: Three blocks, one per booster set. Each block is n on its own line followed by the n values of that set (power_a, then power_b, then power_c).
out: The value your function returns (the driver prints it): the number of players capable of defeating all other players.
cons: Each player's three boosters are distinct

samples.ex: Player 1 has {4, 8, 10} and Player 2 has {2, 5, 12}. Player 1 wins with 4>2, 8>5; Player 2 wins with 5>4, 12>8. Each defeats the other in 2 of 3 rounds, so both are capable: the answer is 2.
The players hold {3,2,8}, {4,11,7}, {1,5,9} and {16,6,10}. Only the players with boosters {4,11,7} and {16,6,10} beat every other player in at least 2 of the 3 rounds, so the answer is 2.
